import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Apply filter for 'MetaSeq' using the searchbox
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by name")
    await searchbox.fill("MetaSeq")
    await searchbox.press("Enter")
    # Wait for the page to update after applying the filter
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait for UI to stabilize
    
    # Step 2: Find and click the link for the MetaSeq project to navigate to its details page
    meta_seq_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="MetaSeq", exact=False)
    await meta_seq_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
